en.headline: Bay of Bengal cyclone may affect Nepal's weather from Kartik 11 to 15 (28 Oct to 1 Nov); DHM asks everyone to stay alert
en.description: Reported (Shilapatra and The Kathmandu Post, both citing the post-monsoon special weather bulletin issued by the DHM Meteorological Forecasting Division on the evening of Kartik 6 (Friday, 23 Oct); the exact issue time is not given, so the time of the first news report is used): a low-pressure area formed over the east-central and adjoining southeastern Bay of Bengal at 5:45 AM on Friday. It may strengthen into a cyclonic storm by Kartik 9 (Monday, 26 Oct) and move towards the coast of northern Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha in India. Because of it, Nepal's weather may be affected from Kartik 11 (Wednesday, 28 Oct) to Kartik 15 (Sunday, 1 Nov). DHM says it is too early to say how much rain Nepal will get or how high the risk will be. It asks everyone to stay alert, as agriculture and tourism could be affected. This is not a colour-coded warning; DHM will issue further updates.
en.instruction: Prepare to protect ripe paddy and crops laid out to dry; before high-mountain treks or long hill journeys from 28 Oct to 1 Nov, check DHM's latest notice.
